sources.evidence: Texture common incref/decref at25-66: only public0->1 pins device, public1->0 drops underlying draw texture reference before releasing device last; internal WineD3D storage holds preserve public-zero objects.
Windows-tested public references at1697-1725: SetTexture and unbind do not increase texture COM refs; GetSurfaceLevel increments shared texture/surface count without another device pin.
SetTexture maps to WineD3D internal stateblock texture holds; GetTexture explicitly AddRefs the public object. Public state-block object reference semantics remain outside this phase.

reference.scope: Stage4J1: D3D9 public2D texture refs separated from sampler and texture-level target private holds. Zero public refs drop exactly one public device pin; GetTexture/GetRenderTarget/GetSurfaceLevel/GetContainer restore shared parent public refs and a pin only on0->1. Private sampler/target holds keep storage, cached surface wrappers, pixels and private data until final public/private release; reusable storage teardown unlinks and cleans before public parent release. Live binding replacement publishes new pointers before releasing old objects; recording/stateblock public holds retain existing semantics. Device clear/Reset uses private2D releases, DEFAULT Reset blockers count external shared public refs rather than discounting private slots. Native actual device/resource/set/query/reset/teardown functions use constructor/emitter stubs:86784 new checks,1024 pool/order profiles,8192 public-zero revivals, four sampler slots plus two target slots,13 strict runtime mutations and old actual methods plus new helper runtime negative control; ASAN/UBSAN. XP actual constructors/COM:two DEFAULT textures,three sampler bindings,128 texture/level revivals,public-zero sampled draw and public-zero RT clear,RT container/query shared count then sampling after target unbind,one refused and one successful Reset,three actual readbacks with simulated transport pixels. Independent GPU replay validates192 red/blue/green pixels and both explicit texture destructions after the Reset command and before post-Reset drawing with empty guest maps before genuine owner release. D3D8/cube/volume/buffer/shader/stateblock public binding refs, general external-child device-state retention, arbitrary callback reentrancy/concurrency, physical loss/full Reset/format/MSAA/fullscreen/multi-buffer/wrapper conversion, native HAL, games/FPS and overall stages4/5/6 remain open. Host/protocol/shader/bundle and D3D8/DDraw DLLs unchanged.

All prior mutations strictly compile and then fail runtime assertions.

Retained implicit-only harness explicitly asserts that its unused texture-child path is not entered. Existing object-recording harness stubs private retain/release as backend construction operations; exact public/private texture lifetime is covered by the new actual-method suite and XP, while recorded public references retain existing behavior. Reset graph test assigns zero public owned refs for private2D slots rather than discounting them.

The first complete263-suite pass exposed7 harness extraction/selector issues after the production lifetime split. After repairs, the accepted full265-suite run passes with all previous checks and new2 suites. An intermediate stub string needed a literal newline escape; no production changes were made for these repairs.

The first wire reader assumed texture destruction precedes RESET. Actual existing Reset queues RESET then drops bound storage before post-Reset rendering. Reader/reference now enforce the actual order, two exact resource destructions, and empty guest maps before genuine owner release, with production/SDK/capture unchanged.

Old actual texture/setter functions compile with new helper declarations and fail the public-count runtime observation. Portable tests surround actual COM/storage/reset functions with constructors/emitters; XP executes full real constructors and queries. Original Microsoft HAL, cube/volume/buffer/shader/stateblock public binding semantics and general external-child root-state retention are not claimed.
